en: A vertically arranged postcard showing three black‑and‑white photographs of early 20th‑century cycling events, all mounted on a decorative clover‑patterned backing. The top image depicts a parade or mass start of cyclists on high‑wheel and safety bicycles riding along a city street lined with spectators and shops. The middle image shows a group of male cyclists posing together, some in racing jerseys, with a bicycle in the foreground. The bottom image captures a steeply banked velodrome track with a motorcycle pacer and cyclists racing along the concrete wall while spectators watch from above. Handwritten German captions are visible on the photographs, mentioning Dresden and Leipzig and naming winning riders.
